dog.description_text:
Meet Mr. Speckles!

Mr. Speckles was found abandoned in an apartment building and is now looking for a safe, loving place to call home. While his past is a mystery, this gentle boy has shown that he wants to connect with people and is ready for a patient person who will help him feel comfortable at his own pace.

My Ideal Home

Mr. Speckles would do best in a calm, quiet home with someone who understands that confidence takes time. He will need slow introductions to new people and places, along with plenty of patience, routine, and positive reinforcement to help him feel secure. A peaceful environment where he can decompress and learn that he is safe will help him shine.

Good with Other Pets?

Mr. Speckles has not shown reactivity toward other dogs while in our care, but his history with other animals is unknown. Slow and thoughtful introductions are recommended for any resident pets.

Good with Kids?

Due to his fearful nature and need for a slow approach, Mr. Speckles would do best in an adult-only home.

Things to Know

Mr. Speckles is a shy and sensitive pup who may need extra time before he feels comfortable in a new environment. He appreciates gentle interactions and should always be allowed to approach people and new experiences at his own pace. Once he feels safe, his sweet personality can begin to shine. If you have a quiet home and a big heart for a dog who needs a little extra patience, Mr. Speckles may be the perfect companion for you.
dog.name: Mr. Speckles
